items.title: Nepal and India PMs inaugurate 669MW Lower Arun project
items.blurb: The Rs92.67 billion hydropower project will use water discharged from the 900MW Arun-3 plant to generate electricity, but financial closure is still pending.

items.title: Nepal and India sign eight MoUs on cooperation in multiple sectors
items.blurb: Agreements cover forensic science, police training, civil service capacity building, satellite communications, health, urban development and traditional medicine.

items.title: Shah and Modi inaugurate bridge, flag off Janakpur-Ayodhya train
items.blurb: The two leaders inaugurate a motorable bridge linking Darchula with India and the second phase of a petroleum pipeline, and lay foundation stones for an integrated check post, oil terminal and hydropower project.

items.title: Indonesia says 24 killed in factory blaze as rescuers search for dozens missing
items.blurb: Around 30 people remain missing as rescuers navigate unstable structures at the burned factory, with a possible air-conditioner short circuit suspected as the cause.

items.title: Indian investors eye expansion in Nepal as Kathmandu courts fresh capital
items.blurb: Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle urges Indian businesses to invest in technology, hydropower and connectivity, while the two countries’ private sectors agree to cooperate on flood recovery.

items.title: Months after flood devastated families, survivors live in trauma
items.blurb: Loss of loved ones, homes and livelihoods, coupled with uncertainty over the future, is taking a heavy toll on the people displaced by the Bhotekoshi disaster.

items.title: Seven body bags recovered, 50 missing after Indonesian factory fire
items.blurb: The factory is part of Indonesia’s United Family Food company, founded in 1981.
